'''Lady Aitalla Girard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of [[House Girard]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. The hired Bounty Hunter was offered a contract to kill her and the entire leadership of house Girard.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
She can be romanced by a male [[Hunter (individual)|Bounty Hunter]] if the player suggests she make a scandal. She can also be crowned [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] at the end of the storyline, if she was not optionally killed to fulfill the optional contract from [[House Rist]]. Aitalla Girard is voiced by [[Courtenay Taylor]].<ref name="TOR" />
